+# Get to Green product-claim validation
+
+Reviewed 17 October 2026. Application reference: `steveholbrook/ptracker3`, main commit `a659d3de53a89cae96b0b2a2e63c0fac6f6c1b8a`. The application repository was read only. No application business logic, data or permissions were changed.
+
+These are implementation checks, not a certification of the current staging deployment. Direct inspection of `https://test.mantiva360.app/` reached its sign-in screen. No authenticated recovery case was opened or modified. Live navigation, project-specific availability, permissions and recovery execution therefore remain unverified. Existing approved marketing captures and the supplied demonstration films are used without rewriting their financial values or status.
+
+| Claim or requirement | Source evidence at the pinned commit | Finding and copy treatment |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Four-step recovery workflow | `app/project-recovery.tsx`, recovery steps navigation | Source labels are Confirm position, Compare options, Approve response, Track recovery. Detect, Decide, Act, Verify are explicitly a marketing framework, with the product labels shown alongside. |
+| Initiate recovery assessment | `app/cockpit-control-workspace.tsx`, Panoramic Cockpit utilities | Assess recovery is a panoramic utility for authorised internal roles. The source also has a standard-view Open project recovery entry. The page describes the panoramic path, without claiming it is the only entry. |
+| Project health, financial and schedule findings | `app/cockpit.tsx`, `app/cockpit-control-workspace.tsx`, `lib/project-recovery.ts` | Current source health and reconciliation findings support diagnosis. A finding is not proof of its root cause. The PM must review source quality and qualifications. |
+| Original commitment and approved baseline | `app/project-recovery.tsx`, starting-position table; `lib/project-recovery.ts`, startingPosition | Original contract value, original delivery cost budget, recovery-entry baseline and current forecast are distinct. Unknown original commitments are not reconstructed as facts. |
+| Actual cost and forecast cost | `lib/project-recovery.ts`, metrics; recovery budget-basis reconciliation | Actual cost, remaining cost, forecast completion cost, baseline cost and eligible EVM measures are separate. Approved funding, resource baseline and mapped EVM budget are not interchangeable. |
+| Recovery scenarios and options | `app/project-recovery.tsx`, Compare options; `lib/project-recovery.ts`, compareRecoveryOption | Core options can link Forecast, Delivery Plan and Change Request scenarios. Options retain assumptions, required outcome, owner, due date and residual risk. Unmodelled options retain the current outlook. Page claims are limited to this existing core workflow. |
+| Advanced comparison table or automatic recommendations | `app/recovery-scenario-review.tsx`, `lib/recovery-scenario-review.ts` | The separate Compare evidenced alternatives pilot is disabled unless explicitly enabled at build time. It does not rank alternatives or authorise decisions. The page omits that pilot, AI-generated recovery recommendations and automatic option selection. |
+| Recovery decision authority | `lib/project-recovery.ts`, response routes; `lib/recovery-governance.ts` | Source correction, recovery within existing authority, formal change and escalation are distinct routes. Scenario selection does not approve budget or publish a plan. |
+| Corrective actions and approval | `lib/corrective-actions.ts`, `lib/recovery-governance.ts`, `app/project-recovery.tsx` | Action ownership, required outcomes, evidence, independent plan approval and verification are implemented. Changes to commitments continue through existing Change Requests. Availability depends on role, authority and source readiness. |
+| Delivery-plan and resource updates | `lib/project-recovery.ts`, linked scenario projection and Change Request route | Source records are updated through their existing governed workflows. The marketing page does not imply automatic execution or silent rebaselining. |
+| Verify recovery | `app/project-recovery.tsx`, Verify recovery now; `lib/project-recovery.ts`, recovery verification | Verification reruns canonical checks. Green health, adequate confidence, complete current inputs, cleared source conditions, capacity and linked action/change obligations matter. Closing an action alone is insufficient. |
+| Sustainable recovery and closure | `lib/recovery-governance.ts`, action verification, observations and closure checks | Current canonical verification, independent action evidence and configured sustained observations support closure. An administrative disposition such as stopped or accepted variance must not be described as recovered. |
+| Freshness and remaining exposure | `lib/project-recovery.ts`, assessment and verification freshness | Changed source records, decisions or evidence require reassessment. Historical receipts do not establish a current green position. The page states this limitation. |
+| Executive reporting | `docs/project-recovery-workflow.md`, Reports lifecycle | Recovery reporting supports reviewed project communication. No automatic report approval, consolidated portfolio recovery dashboard or externally certified outcome is claimed. |
+| Reduce avoidable financial exposure | Inference from connected forecasts, intervention, authority and verification controls | Qualified as an outcome the platform can help support. No measured savings, guaranteed ROI, automatic recovery, client revenue calculation or realised margin improvement is asserted. Commercial judgement remains with the authorised team. |
+| Current screenshots | Existing marketing captures in `public/assets/images/`; supplied films | Approved demonstration assets, not new authenticated staging captures. Captions identify fictional data and distinguish source/finding context from the assessment screens shown in the films. Current staging screenshot parity remains a release check. |
+
+## Financial and media qualifications
+
+Both supplied films visibly contain REVIEW CUT markings and demonstrate a draft, low-confidence, unverified position with missing financial inputs. They illustrate the workflow rather than an achieved financial improvement or verified project recovery. The supplied thumbnail is retained as the financial film poster. Do not describe these assets as a completed customer recovery.
+
+The page avoids unsupported customer outcomes, industry certifications, automatic savings and SAP endorsement. EVM measures depend on the configured progress method and complete eligible inputs. Evidence uploads and Actuals do not independently create earned value.
+
+## Publication decision
+
+The implementation is prepared for review. Before production release, verify the actual staging workflow and current screenshot parity using an authorised demonstration account, review the supplied cuts and caption completeness, confirm the sales mailbox, complete physical Safari/iOS playback review and decide whether to remove the repository's existing review `noindex,nofollow` policy. No merge or production deployment was performed.

+# Get to Green implementation and QA
+
+New route: `/get-to-green`. Review branch: `feature/get-to-green-page`. Production merge and deployment are outside the authorised scope.
+
+## Implementation
+
+- Nine sections follow the requested order, with Detect / Decide / Act / Verify mapped to the application's actual workflow labels.
+- Existing static HTML, shared brand tokens, native dialog/player, email enquiry destination and Firebase Hosting security policy are retained. No runtime dependency, enquiry endpoint, analytics or application change was added.
+- Get to Green appears in desktop/mobile navigation and the footer on all normal routes. Contextual links connect the homepage, Product and SAP Delivery pages. The header's existing collapsed-menu behaviour now applies through 1100 px to accommodate the additional item.
+- One H1, ordered headings, canonical URL, title, description, Open Graph tags, VideoObject microdata, intrinsic image dimensions and XML sitemap inclusion are implemented. The current site-wide review noindex policy is deliberately retained pending approved release.
+- Poster links work without JavaScript. MP4 bodies load only after deliberate playback. Native controls, playsInline, keyboard focus restoration, failure fallback, film descriptions and reduced-motion support use the established architecture.
+
+## Media inspection
+
+| Film | Duration and display | Source size | Integrated size | Treatment |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| From Red to Recovery | 45 seconds, 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, H.264 High / AAC-LC stereo | 5,783,716 bytes | 5,783,716 bytes | Original supplied bytes retained. |
+| What Will Recovery Really Cost? | 70 seconds, 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, H.264 High / AAC-LC stereo | 14,746,164 bytes | 8,722,291 bytes | Web derivative using x264 CRF 18, slow preset and fast-start; original AAC stream copied. |
+
+The financial film is 40.9% smaller. Full-film SSIM against the supplied original is 0.999083. Encoded audio-packet MD5 matches the original for both films. Both originals fully decode without error; audio is present throughout the spoken sections. The 70-second original has two short detected pauses, including its closing silence. This technical inspection does not replace a full human listening and caption-synchronisation review.
+
+Both videos use yuv420p, MP4 avc1 and AAC-LC at 48 kHz. Their moov atoms precede mdat for progressive playback. No separate subtitle track was supplied; visible burned-in captions are preserved. The player does not advertise an optional caption track when none exists. Film descriptions are clearly labelled descriptions, not verbatim transcripts. Full caption completeness and audio description are release-review items.
+
+Hashes, streams, fast-start atom order and audio equality are recorded in [media-validation.json](evidence/get-to-green/media-validation.json), with decoder/audio measurements in [audio-integrity.json](evidence/get-to-green/audio-integrity.json).
+
+## Checks and evidence
+
+`npm test`, `npm run validate` and `git diff --check` pass for the implementation. A dedicated Playwright suite covers six new-page widths (320, 390, 768, 820, 1024 and 1440 px), actual image loading, expanded-disclosure axe WCAG 2.2 AA analysis, deferred downloads, native keyboard playback of both films, duration, seeking, close/stop/focus restoration, navigation/history, the demonstration destination, no-JavaScript reflow, 200% text and reduced motion. The existing 26 browser checks remain in the full regression suite.
+
+An earlier local run passed the existing 26 browser checks and the new page checks after correcting 200% text overflow. Workspace maintenance subsequently removed the checkout and browser runtime. Final source and the optimised film have therefore been submitted to the repository's CI browser suite and Lighthouse workflow for a fresh authoritative run. Local browser installation currently fails with a truncated download; a launch failure is an infrastructure failure, not a page-test result. Final CI evidence and metrics will be appended when available.
+
+The performance workflow measures this route on Lighthouse mobile and desktop profiles. Synthetic LCP, CLS and total blocking time will be reported from actual output. INP requires representative interaction/field data and will not be claimed from a Lighthouse load audit. Local/CDN deployment performance and physical device behaviour may differ.
+
+## Release limitations
+
+1. Staging inspection reached a sign-in screen. Product claims are source-verified, while authenticated live workflow, project availability and current screenshots remain unverified. See [the claim matrix](get-to-green-product-validation.md).
+2. Supplied films and thumbnail contain REVIEW CUT markings and show incomplete demonstration financial inputs. The website does not represent their draft/unverified state as a successful recovery.
+3. No physical Safari/iOS or Edge test, screen-reader certification, full listening review or external mailbox receipt test has been completed. Mailto links use the existing sales mailbox and do not confirm a booking or send a message automatically.
+4. Keep this PR in draft until the release reviewer accepts the media, authenticated product check and indexing decision. No merge or production deployment has been performed.

+# Get to Green implementation and QA
+
+New route: `/get-to-green`. Review branch: `feature/get-to-green-page`. Production merge and deployment are outside the authorised scope.
+
+## Implementation
+
+- Nine sections follow the requested order, with Detect / Decide / Act / Verify mapped to the application's actual workflow labels.
+- Existing static HTML, shared brand tokens, native dialog/player, email enquiry destination and Firebase Hosting security policy are retained. No runtime dependency, enquiry endpoint, analytics or application change was added.
+- Get to Green appears in desktop/mobile navigation and the footer on all normal routes. Contextual links connect the homepage, Product and SAP Delivery pages. The header's existing collapsed-menu behaviour now applies through 1100 px to accommodate the additional item.
+- One H1, ordered headings, canonical URL, title, description, Open Graph tags, VideoObject microdata, intrinsic image dimensions and XML sitemap inclusion are implemented. The current site-wide review noindex policy is deliberately retained pending approved release.
+- Poster links work without JavaScript. MP4 bodies load only after deliberate playback. Native controls, playsInline, keyboard focus restoration, failure fallback, film descriptions and reduced-motion support use the established architecture.
+
+## Media inspection
+
+| Film | Duration and display | Source size | Integrated size | Treatment |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| From Red to Recovery | 45 seconds, 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, H.264 High / AAC-LC stereo | 5,783,716 bytes | 5,783,716 bytes | Original supplied bytes retained. |
+| What Will Recovery Really Cost? | 70 seconds, 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, H.264 High / AAC-LC stereo | 14,746,164 bytes | 8,722,291 bytes | Web derivative using x264 CRF 18, slow preset and fast-start; original AAC stream copied. |
+
+The financial film is 40.9% smaller. Full-film SSIM against the supplied original is 0.999083. Encoded audio-packet MD5 matches the original for both films. Both originals fully decode without error; audio is present throughout the spoken sections. The 70-second original has two short detected pauses, including its closing silence. This technical inspection does not replace a full human listening and caption-synchronisation review.
+
+Both videos use yuv420p, MP4 avc1 and AAC-LC at 48 kHz. Their moov atoms precede mdat for progressive playback. No separate subtitle track was supplied; visible burned-in captions are preserved. The player does not advertise an optional caption track when none exists. Film descriptions are clearly labelled descriptions, not verbatim transcripts. Full caption completeness and audio description are release-review items.
+
+Hashes, streams, fast-start atom order and audio equality are recorded in [media-validation.json](evidence/get-to-green/media-validation.json), with decoder/audio measurements in [audio-integrity.json](evidence/get-to-green/audio-integrity.json).
+
+## Checks and evidence
+
+`npm test`, `npm run validate` and `git diff --check` pass for the implementation. A dedicated Playwright suite covers six new-page widths (320, 390, 768, 820, 1024 and 1440 px), actual image loading, expanded-disclosure axe WCAG 2.2 AA analysis, deferred downloads, native keyboard playback of both films, duration, seeking, close/stop/focus restoration, navigation/history, the demonstration destination, no-JavaScript reflow, 200% text and reduced motion. The existing 26 browser checks remain in the full regression suite.
+
+An earlier local run passed the existing 26 browser checks and the new page checks after correcting 200% text overflow. Workspace maintenance subsequently removed the checkout and browser runtime. Final source and the optimised film have therefore been submitted to the repository's CI browser suite and Lighthouse workflow for a fresh authoritative run. Local browser installation currently fails with a truncated download; a launch failure is an infrastructure failure, not a page-test result. Final CI evidence and metrics will be appended when available.
+
+The performance workflow measures this route on Lighthouse mobile and desktop profiles. Synthetic LCP, CLS and total blocking time will be reported from actual output. INP requires representative interaction/field data and will not be claimed from a Lighthouse load audit. Local/CDN deployment performance and physical device behaviour may differ.
+
+## Release limitations
+
+1. Staging inspection reached a sign-in screen. Product claims are source-verified, while authenticated live workflow, project availability and current screenshots remain unverified. See [the claim matrix](get-to-green-product-validation.md).
+2. Supplied films and thumbnail contain REVIEW CUT markings and show incomplete demonstration financial inputs. The website does not represent their draft/unverified state as a successful recovery.
+3. No physical Safari/iOS or Edge test, screen-reader certification, full listening review or external mailbox receipt test has been completed. Mailto links use the existing sales mailbox and do not confirm a booking or send a message automatically.
+4. Keep this PR in draft until the release reviewer accepts the media, authenticated product check and indexing decision. No merge or production deployment has been performed.
